# Run summaries [»](https://docs.spacelift.io/concepts/run/summarization\#run-summaries "Anchor link to this section")

Spacelift can summarize your runs with AI to explain what happened and why a run failed. Summaries and suggested fixes are delivered through [Infra Assistant](https://docs.spacelift.io/concepts/intelligence/infra-assistant), Spacelift's AI-powered chat interface, and are part of **Spacelift Intelligence** alongside [Intent](https://docs.spacelift.io/concepts/intelligence/intent).

## Enabling run summaries [»](https://docs.spacelift.io/concepts/run/summarization\#enabling-run-summaries "Anchor link to this section")

Run summaries are delivered through Infra Assistant, so an organization admin needs to enable it in **Settings** \> **Spacelift Intelligence**. The first time you enable any Spacelift Intelligence feature, you will be asked to accept the [AI Terms of Use](https://docs.spacelift.io/legal/ai-terms).

1. Turn on **Enable Spacelift Intelligence AI features**.
2. Turn on **Infra Assistant**.

![Spacelift Intelligence settings](https://docs.spacelift.io/assets/screenshots/run/settings-spacelift-intelligence.png)

Once Infra Assistant is enabled, all users with read access to runs can summarize them. For more on configuring Infra Assistant, see [Enabling Infra Assistant](https://docs.spacelift.io/concepts/intelligence/infra-assistant#enabling-infra-assistant).

## Summarizing a run [»](https://docs.spacelift.io/concepts/run/summarization\#summarizing-a-run "Anchor link to this section")

On a failed or stopped run, you can ask for an AI summary at two levels:

- **Summarize** a single completed phase (for example, the planning phase) to get guidance on what went wrong in that step.
- **Explain** the whole run to combine its phases into a single summary. This is ideal for catching issues that span multiple phases.

Either action opens Infra Assistant with a summarization prompt prepared for that run. Send the prompt, and the assistant inspects the run's state, history, and policy outcomes before replying.

![Summarizing a run with Infra Assistant](https://docs.spacelift.io/assets/screenshots/run/infra-assistant-run-summary.png)

The assistant responds with a plain-language summary of what happened, the cause of the failure, and concrete steps to fix it.

![Infra Assistant fix suggestions](https://docs.spacelift.io/assets/screenshots/run/infra-assistant-run-fix.png)

Because the response is generated by an LLM, the exact wording varies between runs, but a summary generally includes:

- A human-readable summary of the logs.
- Detailed information on what went wrong.
- Code snippet suggestions to help solve the issue.

The summary is generated using the AI model selected in the Infra Assistant model picker. See [AI Integrations](https://docs.spacelift.io/concepts/intelligence/ai-integrations#selecting-an-integration-in-infra-assistant) for how to choose a model or configure additional providers.

Tip

Infra Assistant can do much more than summarize runs. It can answer infrastructure questions, debug issues, and manage resources through conversation. See [Infra Assistant](https://docs.spacelift.io/concepts/intelligence/infra-assistant) to learn more.
